text:
Olivia Rivera: Heads up — saw an uptick in client errors overnight where requests with X-API-Version: 2025-12 were getting rejected as 400. 12 tenants affected. We should fail open instead of hard-failing. @Chris can you help spec a tolerant behavior?
Chris Park: Yep saw the logs. The gateway currently treats unknown versions as invalid. Suggestion: accept unknown version, route to a compat path, and emit telemetry so we can track.
Devon Singh: Agreed. Prefer to map unknown->latest-compatible and return a Warning header to the client. If the request uses a truly incompatible shape (new required param), then 422 makes sense.
Olivia Rivera: Draft proposal: 1) unknown X-API-Version -> mark req with X-Compat-Probe:1 and route to compat-router 2) add X-Api-Fallback:true in response 3) emit metric client_version_mismatch{client_version,tenant} 4) do not break existing flows.
Chris Park: One edge: SDKs sometimes assert unknown version and drop requests. We should add a probe-mode header so SDKs can opt-in and we can experiment.
Devon Singh: Implementation sketch for middleware:
```js
// pseudo
if (!knownVersions.includes(req.get('X-API-Version'))) {
  req.set('X-Compat-Probe', '1')
  req.set('X-Api-Fallback', 'latest-compat')
  // tag for telemetry
  req.ctx._meta.client_version = req.get('X-API-Version') || 'none'
}
```
This keeps routing cheap and observable.
Olivia Rivera: +1. Also add an opt-in header X-Compat-Opt-In for tenants that want to test.
infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: canary rollout scheduled to us-west-2 at 1715254800, percentage=5% :gear:
Zara Liu: Test plan: unit tests for parser, e2e with synthetic clients sending unknown versions, load test for overhead, and a dashboard showing fallback_rate, client_version_mismatch, p50/p95 latency. Add alert if error_rate or latency spikes post-rollout.
Chris Park: Rollout plan: feature flag gated; 0.5% for 24h -> 5% for 48h -> 25% if stable. Watch fallback_rate, errors, and correctness checks.
Devon Singh: SDKs: will open PRs for js/python to stop throwing on unknown X-API-Version and to expose opt-in header. Also add a deprecation warning in responses so clients can update.
Olivia Rivera: Action items: Chris -> middleware + FF (due Fri). Devon -> SDK PRs. Zara -> tests + dashboard. I'll draft a short RFC patch to eng-platform about the compatibility signal and runbook.
Chris Park: ack :thumbsup:
Zara Liu: I'll add a synthetic traffic generator script under infra/tests/replay and a smoke test to run in CI.
Olivia Rivera: Final note: keep behavior conservative — only route to compat when safe, emit lots of telemetry, and surface a non-blocking Warning header to clients so we can track adoption. I'll follow up with a short announcement template for partners. Thanks!
